source: original, modeled on AA SL 2022 Nov P1 Q8(a) and Math SL 2018 Nov P1 Q4

parts.label: a_i
parts.description: Evaluate log_4(1/64)
parts.notes: M1 for rewriting 1/64 as a power of 4 (or equivalent). A1 for -3.

parts.label: a_ii
parts.description: Evaluate log_25(5)
parts.notes: M1 for recognising 5 = 25^(1/2) (or equivalent). A1 for 1/2.

parts.label: a_iii
parts.description: Evaluate log_2(sqrt(32))
parts.notes: M1 for rewriting sqrt(32) as 2^(5/2) (or equivalent). A1 for 5/2.

parts.label: b_i
parts.description: Express log_3(m^2) in terms of c = log_3(m)
parts.notes: M1 for applying log(m^n) = n log(m). A1 for 2c.

parts.label: b_ii
parts.description: Express log_3(27m) in terms of c
parts.notes: M1 for applying log(ab) = log(a) + log(b) with log_3(27) = 3. A1 for 3 + c.

parts.label: b_iii
parts.description: Express log_9(m) in terms of c
parts.notes: M1 for change of base (log_3 m)/(log_3 9) or equivalent. A1 for c/2.

source: original, modeled on Math SL 2019 May P1 TZ2 Q6

parts.description: Solve log_2(x-3) = log_4(x+9)
parts.notes: M1 for change of base (log_4 = (1/2) log_2) or equivalent. A1 for 2 log_2(x-3) = log_2(x+9). M1 for equating arguments: (x-3)^2 = x+9. A1 for x^2 - 7x = 0. A1 for x = 0 or x = 7. R1 for rejecting x = 0 using domain x > 3. A1 for x = 7.

source: AA SL 2022 May P1 TZ1 Q08

parts.label: a_i
parts.description: Show p = ±1/sqrt(3) for geometric series
parts.notes: M1 for setting up common ratio equation p = 1/(3p) or equivalent. A1 for p^2 = 1/3. AG.

parts.label: a_ii
parts.description: Find x given p = 1/sqrt(3) and S_infinity = 3 + sqrt(3)
parts.notes: M1 for applying S_infinity = a/(1-r). A1 for ln(x) = 2 (or equivalent). A1 for x = e^2.

parts.label: b_i
parts.description: Show p = 2/3 for arithmetic series
parts.notes: M1 for equal-difference setup: p ln x - ln x = (1/3) ln x - p ln x. A1 for 2p = 4/3. AG.

parts.label: b_ii
parts.description: Write d in form k ln x
parts.notes: A1 for d = -(1/3) ln x.

parts.label: b_iii
parts.description: Find n such that S_n = -3 ln x
parts.notes: M1 for applying S_n = (n/2)[2a + (n-1)d]. A1 for substituting a = ln x and d = -(1/3) ln x. A1 for simplified S_n = n(7-n) ln(x)/6. M1 for setting equal to -3 ln x and dividing by ln x. A1 for n^2 - 7n - 18 = 0. A1 for factored form (n-9)(n+2) = 0. A1 for n = 9 (rejecting n = -2).
parts.follow_through: If candidate's d from (b)(ii) is wrong but they correctly apply S_n formula, award M1 A1 M1 for the method.

parts.label: a
parts.description: Coordinates of B (reflection of A in y=x)
parts.notes: A1 for recognising a = q+1. A1 for B = (a, 0).

parts.label: b
parts.description: Equation of L1 in terms of x, p, q
parts.notes: M1 for using point-gradient form at B(a, 0) with gradient 1/ln(p). A1 for substituting B and gradient. M1 for substituting a = q+1. A1 A1 for final equation.
parts.follow_through: Award A1 A1 for final equation using candidate's a from part (a).

parts.label: c
parts.description: Find equation of L1 in terms of x
parts.notes: M1 for using normal-gradient relation (gradients multiply to -1). A1 for ln(p) = ln 3. A1 for p = 3. A1 for substituting (-2,-2) into L2 equation. A1 for q = -3 + 2 ln 3. A1 for a = -2 + 2 ln 3. A1 for final L1 equation.

parts.label: a
parts.description: Initial displacement s(0)
parts.notes: M1 for substituting t = 0 into s(t) = 3(t+2)cos(t). A1 for 6 (metres).

parts.label: b
parts.description: Velocity at t = 2
parts.notes: M1 for derivative v(t) = 3cos(t) - 3(t+2)sin(t). A1 for GDC-evaluated value at t = 2.

parts.label: c
parts.description: Intervals when particle is moving away from P
parts.notes: A1 for zeros of s at t = π/2 and 3π/2. M1 for using GDC to solve v(t) = 0. A1 for zeros of v at t ≈ 0.402, 3.33, 6.41. A1 for method of checking sign of s and v (same sign means moving away). A1 for three correct intervals.

parts.label: d
parts.description: Find b and c where acceleration is zero
parts.notes: M1 for a(t) = -6sin(t) - 3(t+2)cos(t). M1 for solving a(t) = 0 with GDC. A1 for b. A1 for c.

parts.label: e
parts.description: Total distance travelled for b ≤ t ≤ c
parts.notes: M1 for splitting at v = 0 at t ≈ 3.33 in (b, c) and using |s(3.33) - s(b)| + |s(c) - s(3.33)|. A1 for intermediate s values. A1 for total distance ≈ 31.7 m.
